channel.title: Bangu Kwetu
channel.description: Independent news covering Eastlands, Nairobi — Kariobangi North, Dandora, Embakasi North, and Outering.

item.title: Gikomba Market Takes Shape as Nairobi Redevelopment Moves Forward
item.description: Three new multi-storey blocks are taking shape at Gikomba as Nairobi's major market undergoes redevelopment aimed at improving trading and safety.

item.title: From Kitui to Malkia Strikers: Josephine Kataa's Rise Continues
item.description: Josephine Kataa's journey from Kitui to Malkia Strikers highlights the rise of a new generation of Kenyan volleyball talent.

item.title: Kenya Targets 5,500MW Power Capacity in Major Energy Expansion
item.description: Kenya is targeting 5,500MW of power capacity as it expands nuclear, geothermal and hydropower projects to meet rising electricity demand.

item.title: Kenya to Import 25 Million Bags of Maize Amid Looming Food Shortage
item.description: Kenya will import 25 million bags of maize to address an expected food deficit after poor harvests raise concerns over future supplies and prices.

item.title: EPRA Cuts Diesel Price by KSh5 as New Fuel Rates Take Effect
item.description: EPRA has cut diesel by KSh5 per litre, while petrol and kerosene prices remain unchanged under new fuel rates taking effect across Kenya

item.title: Nairobi Weather: Cool and Cloudy Conditions Expected This Week
item.description: Nairobi is expected to experience intermittent cool and cloudy conditions as Kenya Met forecasts generally dry weather across most of the country.

item.title: Parklands Demolition Claims Clarified as Nairobi River Work Continues
item.description: Nairobi authorities have clarified viral claims about Parklands demolitions as the city continues its programme to restore riparian land along the river.

item.title: From Lima to the estate, Kenya’s U20 stars and the fight for the future
item.description: Kenya finished second overall at the World U20 Championships in Lima, led by Franklin Kibet and a new wave of runners.

item.title: Ruto, Oburu Oginga Open Naivasha Retreat to Forge 2027 Deal
item.description: Ruto and ODM leader Oburu Oginga open a Naivasha retreat to finalize a joint manifesto, with the 2027 running-mate question moving to centre stage.

item.title: Dangote Confirms Lamu Oil Refinery Construction Starts in October 2026
item.description: Dangote says Lamu Oil Refinery construction starts in October 2026, promising jobs, fuel security and fresh investment for Kenya’s coast.

item.title: Gor Mahia’s Kagame Cup Run Leaves Club With More to Prove
item.description: Gor Mahia’s Kagame Cup run showed promise, but the final defeat to Rayon Sports raised fresh questions ahead of their next continental test

item.title: Harambee Starlets Captain Jereko Scores as HB Køge Reach Qualifiers
item.description: Harambee Starlets captain Mwanalima Jereko scored as HB Køge came from behind to beat Hearts 2–1 and reach the final Champions League qualifying round.

item.title: Blackout Hits Western Kenya After Fire at Kakamega Substation
item.description: Kakamega substation fire has caused a blackout in western Kenya, with Kenya Power restoring electricity in phases.

item.title: Malindi Court: Presidential Election Due August 2026, Not 2027
item.description: Malindi High Court rules Kenya’s next presidential election should have been held in August 2026, not 2027, citing the Constitution.
